overviewHtml:
Overview of Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek 15 Days

Embark on the Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek with a detailed 15-day itinerary, cost breakdown, and expert tips. Crossing high-altitude passes and reaching Gokyo Lake will be an unforgettable adventure. The Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek 15 Days is an alternative way to escape the mainstream trail of the Everest Base Camp Trek and another way to explore the next trekking trails in the Everest region. From lush green forests to stunning streams and high mountain passes, this trek unveils the true marvels of nature.

With its enticing features, away from the crowd, this trek offers the exclusive Himalayas as you explore the tempting Gokyo Valley Trek. Get to the top of the mountain pass, marvel at the sparkling Gokyo Lake, and explore pristine valleys and lofty mountains all at once. The Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek 15 days follows the Sherpa’s heartland trail and provides a breathtaking view of the Himalayas – Mt. Everest (8,848m), Mt. Lhotse, Mt. Nuptse, Mt. Ama Dablam, Mt. Cho Oyu, Mt. Makalu, and more. You will stay at a local teahouse which provides an opportunity to explore local culture and tradition firsthand. You will be privileged to receive such warm hospitality and friendliness.

The Nepal Unique Treks has designed a 15-day Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek, including your arrival and departure plus a day sightseeing tour in the Kathmandu valley. The trek starts with an exciting flight to Lukla and follows a steep river valley to Namche Bazaar via Sagarmatha National Park a UNESCO world heritage site of great natural value).

You will spend two nights at Namche: which ensures proper acclimatization. The trekking trip then continues following the northern Dudh Koshi Valley to reach Gokyo Lakes (the collection of pristine lakes). A pre-dawn hike to Gokyo Ri guarantees remarkable views of four out of the six highest peaks Everest (8,848m), Makalu, Cho Oyu (8,153m), and Lhotse (8,511m) plus Nzogumpa Glacier (the largest Himalayan Glacier in the world).

The Renjo La Pass trail goes via a rarely used mountain track. The top of the pass rewards you with an unbelievable view of Gokyo Lakes on one side, the Rermo Pokhari Lake on the other side, and an array of snowy peaks in the background. If you want more adventure and to push your limit, we suggest the Everest Three High Pass Trek that incorporates the crossing of three high mountain passes

Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek 15 Days Highlights

  • Experience one of the most spectacular Everest Region Trekking adventures, combining the breathtaking Gokyo Valley with the thrilling Renjo La Pass (5,360m).
  • Enjoy a quieter alternative to the classic Everest Base Camp Trek, perfect for trekkers seeking fewer crowds and untouched Himalayan landscapes.
  • Witness unforgettable panoramic views of Mt. Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu, Ama Dablam, Nuptse, Thamserku, and dozens of snow-covered Himalayan peaks.
  • Hike to the famous Gokyo Ri (5,360m), one of the finest viewpoints in Trekking in Nepal, overlooking the emerald Gokyo Lakes and the massive Ngozumpa Glacier.
  • Cross the scenic Renjo La Pass, one of the most rewarding high mountain passes in the Everest region with stunning 360-degree mountain panoramas.
  • Explore the sacred turquoise Gokyo Lakes, among the world's highest freshwater lake systems and an important pilgrimage site for both Hindus and Buddhists.
  • Trek through the UNESCO-listed Sagarmatha National Park, home to Himalayan wildlife including musk deer, Himalayan thar, colorful pheasants, and, with luck, the elusive snow leopard.
  • Discover authentic Sherpa culture by visiting traditional mountain villages including Namche Bazaar, Dole, Machhermo, Gokyo, Lungden, and Thame.
  • Visit the historic Thame Monastery, one of the oldest and most respected Buddhist monasteries in the Khumbu region.
  • Walk beside the impressive Ngozumpa Glacier, the longest glacier in Nepal's Himalayas, offering dramatic alpine scenery.
  • Enjoy comfortable tea house accommodation while experiencing genuine Sherpa hospitality, local cuisine, and rich Himalayan traditions.
  • Follow well-planned acclimatization days that increase your chances of a safe and enjoyable high-altitude trekking experience.
  • Capture incredible sunrise and sunset photography over the Himalayan giants from Gokyo Ri and Renjo La Pass.
  • Fly into the legendary mountain airstrip at Lukla, one of the world's most exciting gateway airports for Everest Region Trek adventures.
  • Perfect for trekkers looking for a challenging yet rewarding journey that combines spectacular mountain scenery, pristine lakes, Buddhist culture, and unforgettable Himalayan wilderness.
  • Professionally organized by Nepal Unique Treks with experienced local guides, licensed porters, personalized service, and carefully designed itineraries for a memorable Trekking in Nepal experience.

Why Choose the Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek?

The Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek is one of the most rewarding adventures in the Everest Region Trek, offering a perfect combination of breathtaking Himalayan scenery, pristine alpine lakes, authentic Sherpa culture, and challenging high-altitude trekking. Unlike the classic Everest Base Camp Trek, this route follows quieter mountain trails, allowing trekkers to experience the peaceful beauty of the Khumbu region away from the busiest trekking paths.

This trek takes you through the spectacular Gokyo Valley, where a chain of sacred turquoise lakes lies beneath towering Himalayan peaks. One of the greatest highlights is climbing Gokyo Ri (5,360m), widely considered one of the finest viewpoints in the Himalayas. From the summit, you can admire panoramic views of Mount Everest, Cho Oyu, Lhotse, Makalu, Ama Dablam, Nuptse, Thamserku, and many other snow-capped giants.

Crossing the magnificent Renjo La Pass (5,360m) is another unforgettable experience. The pass rewards trekkers with breathtaking mountain scenery, dramatic glacier landscapes, and spectacular photography opportunities that few trekking routes can match.

Along the journey, you'll walk through Sagarmatha National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site rich in biodiversity. Dense rhododendron forests, alpine meadows, Himalayan wildlife, and the impressive Ngozumpa Glacier create an ever-changing landscape throughout the trek.

Beyond its natural beauty, the trek provides a genuine cultural experience. Traditional Sherpa villages such as Namche Bazaar, Dole, Machhermo, Gokyo, Lungden, and Thame offer warm hospitality, centuries-old monasteries, colorful prayer flags, and fascinating Buddhist traditions that make Trekking in Nepal a truly unforgettable experience.

Whether you're looking for a scenic alternative to the Everest Base Camp Trek or an adventurous high-pass journey, the Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek delivers exceptional mountain views, rich culture, and lifelong memories.

Route Description

Your adventure begins with a thrilling mountain flight from Kathmandu to Lukla, the gateway to the Everest region. From Lukla, the trail gradually ascends through picturesque Sherpa villages, pine forests, suspension bridges, and rushing rivers before reaching the vibrant trading town of Namche Bazaar.

After acclimatizing in Namche, the route leaves the busy Everest Base Camp trail and heads toward the peaceful Gokyo Valley Trek. The landscape changes dramatically as you hike through alpine pastures, glacial rivers, and remote mountain settlements surrounded by towering Himalayan peaks.

Upon reaching Gokyo Village, you'll explore the famous Gokyo Lakes and hike to Gokyo Ri for one of Nepal's most spectacular sunrise panoramas. The trek then continues across the challenging Renjo La Pass, where magnificent views stretch across Everest, Cho Oyu, the Gokyo Lakes, and the surrounding glaciers.

Descending into the beautiful Bhote Koshi Valley, you'll pass through Lungden and the historic village of Thame before returning to Namche Bazaar and finally Lukla. This circular route showcases two completely different landscapes, making it one of the most diverse trekking experiences in the Everest region.

Best Time for the Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek

The best seasons for Trekking in Nepal on the Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek are spring and autumn, when weather conditions are generally stable and mountain views are at their finest.

Spring (March to May)

Spring transforms the Everest region into a colorful paradise. Rhododendron forests bloom across the lower hills, temperatures are comfortable, and skies are usually clear. This is an excellent season for photographers and nature lovers seeking vibrant landscapes and excellent mountain visibility.

Autumn (September to November)

Autumn is considered the most popular trekking season in Nepal. Fresh mountain air, crystal-clear skies, pleasant daytime temperatures, and excellent trail conditions make it ideal for crossing Renjo La Pass and enjoying uninterrupted Himalayan panoramas.

Winter (December to February)

Winter trekking offers peaceful trails and dramatic snow-covered landscapes. Although temperatures can fall well below freezing at higher elevations, experienced trekkers can still enjoy incredible mountain scenery with proper equipment and preparation.

Monsoon (June to August)

Heavy rainfall affects the lower trekking trails during summer, while clouds may limit mountain visibility. However, the upper valleys often receive less rainfall due to the Himalayan rain shadow, making trekking possible for well-prepared adventurers.

Trek Difficulty

The Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek is considered a moderately challenging to strenuous Everest Region Trek. It is suitable for physically fit trekkers who enjoy hiking and are prepared for several consecutive days of mountain walking.

The highest point of the trek is Renjo La Pass (5,360m), where thinner air makes hiking more demanding. Daily trekking generally lasts between 5 and 7 hours across rocky trails, glacial moraines, and mountain passes.

Previous high-altitude trekking experience is helpful but not essential. Proper acclimatization, a gradual ascent, experienced local guides, and maintaining a comfortable pace significantly reduce the risk of altitude sickness. Regular walking, hiking, cycling, or cardiovascular exercise before your trip will greatly improve your trekking experience.

Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek Cost

The cost of the Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek varies depending on group size, accommodation preferences, trekking season, and included services.

A standard package generally includes:

  • Airport transfers in Kathmandu

  • 3 Night Three Star Hotel with Breakfast

  • Kathmandu to Ramechhap and Kathmandu by private Car, Jeep, Van
  • Domestic flights between Ramechhap and Lukla
  • Comfortable tea house accommodation during the trek
  • Experienced English-speaking licensed trekking guide
  • Strong and reliable porter service
  • Sagarmatha National Park Permit
  • Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality Permit
  • Three nutritious meals during the trek
  • Government taxes and company service charges
  • Additional personal expenses may include travel insurance, Nepal entry visa, international flights, personal trekking equipment, hot showers, charging devices, Wi-Fi, drinks, snacks, and tips for guides and porters.

Booking with Nepal Unique Treks ensures transparent pricing, experienced local staff, personalized service, and excellent value for an unforgettable Himalayan adventure.

itinerary.title: Arrivel in Kathmandu, Welcome by Nepal Unique Treks Guide 1400
itinerary.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (KTM). Met by a representative from the trekking agency and transferred to your hotel in Kathmandu (Thamel area is typical). Rest of the day free for a welcome briefing, currency exchange, and adjusting to the time zone. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Trekking Gear preparation and meeting with adventure team at Kathmandu Hotel. 1345m.
itinerary.description: Full day in Kathmandu to finalize trekking permits (Sagarmatha National Park entry permit and Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality permit), meet your guide and support crew, and check/rent any remaining gear. A pre-trek briefing covers altitude sickness awareness, daily routines, and what to expect on the trail. Optional sightseeing at Kathmandu Durbar Square, Swayambhunath, or Boudhanath if time allows. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drive to Ramechhap 145 km, 5 hrs, Fly to Lukla 2850 m, Trek to Phakding 2650 m, 8 km
itinerary.description: Kathmandu to Ramechhap (Manthali Airport) 145 km, 5 hrs by road, departing around 2:00 AM to reach in time for the morning flight window (flights to Lukla now typically operate from Manthali during peak season to reduce Kathmandu air traffic congestion). Ramechhap to Lukla: short scenic mountain flight (15–20 minutes) landing at Tenzing-Hillary Airport, Lukla (2,850m). Lukla to Phakding: 8 km, 3–4 hrs trek, mostly downhill/gentle through Chheplung and Ghat villages along the Dudh Koshi River. Overnight in Phakding (2,650m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar (3,440m), 11 km, 6/7 hrs
itinerary.description: The trail crosses several suspension bridges over the Dudh Koshi River, passes through Monjo (entry point to Sagarmatha National Park where permits are checked), and Jorsalle, before a steep, sustained climb of roughly 600–700m elevation gain up to Namche Bazaar, the main Sherpa trading hub of the Khumbu. First good views of Mount Everest possible en route near Jorsalle/Namche entry point on a clear day.

itinerary.title: Rest and acclimatization day at Namche Bazaar 3440 m
itinerary.description: Rest day for altitude acclimatization following the "climb high, sleep low" principle. Popular side hikes include Everest View Hotel (3,880m) or the Khumjung/Khunde villages, roughly 5–7 km round trip, 3–4 hrs. Overnight again in Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche Bazaar – Dole 4,100 m, 11 km, 6 hours
itinerary.description: The trail splits from the main Everest Base Camp route near Kyangjuma/Sanasa, heading north toward the Gokyo Valley through rhododendron and pine forest, with fine views of Ama Dablam, Thamserku, and Kangtega along the way.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dole – Machhermo (4,400m), 6 km, 5 hours
itinerary.description: A shorter but steadily climbing day, gaining roughly 370m, allowing gradual acclimatization as the valley opens up with views of Cho Oyu in the distance.

itinerary.title: Trek from Machhermo – Gokyo (4,750 m), 7 km, 4 hours
itinerary.description: The trail follows the Dudh Koshi valley, passing the first and second Gokyo lakes (Longpongo and Taboche Tsho) before reaching the third lake, on whose shore Gokyo village sits.

itinerary.title: Hike up to Gokyo Ri (5,360 m) and Acclamatazation in Gokyo Lake.
itinerary.description: An early pre-dawn climb to the summit of Gokyo Ri (3 km one way, 2–3 hrs up, 1–2 hrs down) rewards trekkers with one of the best panoramic views in the Khumbu, four 8,000m peaks (Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu) plus the Ngozumpa Glacier, Nepal's largest. Rest of the day for acclimatization around Gokyo Lake, or an optional visit to the 4th and 5th lakes.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gokyo Lake to Lungden (4,380m) via Renjo La Pass 5360 m, 13 km, 8/9 hrs
itinerary.description: The most demanding day of the trek. Departs early to cross Renjo La (5,360m), a high, sometimes icy pass offering spectacular views back over the Gokyo lakes and Everest massif, before a long, steep descent into the Bhote Koshi valley to the small settlement of Lungden (also spelled Lumde).

itinerary.title: Trek from Lungden to Thame 3820 m, 13 km, 7/8 hrs
itinerary.description: The descending through Marulung and Taranga villages along the Bhote Koshi River to Thame, a historic Sherpa village and home to Thame Monastery, one of the oldest and most important Buddhist monasteries in the Khumbu region, closely associated with climbing legends including Tenzing Norgay and Apa Sherpa.

itinerary.title: Trek from Thame to Namche (3,440m), 10 km, 6 /7 hours
itinerary.description: retracing the Bhote Koshi valley trail back down to rejoin the main Everest trekking route at Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche to Lukla 2850 m, 19 km, 7/8 hours
itinerary.description: Today is a long final trekking day retracing the route back through Jorsalle, Monjo, and Phakding to Lukla.

itinerary.title: Flight from Lukla – Ramechhap - Drive to Kathmandu 1400 m, 5 hrs
itinerary.description: Early morning flight from Lukla to Ramechhap (Manthali), followed by a 145 km, 5 hr road transfer back to Kathmandu. Nepal Unique Trek Invite you to join for farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport for departure, or extend your stay in Nepal.

liveFaqs.question: Is the Gokyo Renjo La Pass Trek harder than the Everest Base Camp Trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Yes. Crossing Renjo La Pass makes this trek slightly more demanding than the classic Everest Base Camp Trek due to the higher elevation and steeper mountain trails.

liveFaqs.question: How Many Days Trek?
liveFaqs.answer: The standard itinerary is 15 days, including arrival, domestic flights, acclimatization, trekking, and departure.

liveFaqs.question: What is the highest point of the trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Renjo La Pass and Gokyo Ri both reach approximately 5,360 meters above sea level.

liveFaqs.question: Can beginners join this trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Yes. Trekkers with good physical fitness, positive determination, and proper preparation can successfully complete this adventure under the guidance of experienced trekking professionals.
